create or alter procedure [dbo].[CheckDisplayValues] AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
insert into AssetDisplayValue (AssetID, DisplayValue, DisplayValueHash, DisplayValuePrefix, UpdatedOn) select A.ID, ADV.DisplayValue, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),HashBytes('SHA1', ADV.DisplayValue),2) as DisplayValueHash, SUBSTRING(ADV.DisplayValue, 1, 250) as DisplayValuePrefix, getutcdate() from Asset A cross apply GetAssetDisplayValueByID(A.ID) ADV where ADV.DisplayValue is not null and not exists ( select 1 from assetdisplayvalue ad where ad.assetid = A.id) END
